panchakarma_protocols.source: Ashtanga Hridayam Sutrasthana Ch. 16 — Sneha-Vidhi Adhyaya
panchakarma_protocols.definition: The process of producing unctuousness (snigdhata), fluidity, softness and smoothness in the body. Oleation is mandatory pre-operative procedure (purva karma) before all Panchakarma therapies.
panchakarma_protocols.role_in_panchakarma: Purva karma (pre-operative) — brings vitiated dosas from sakha (periphery) back to kostha (central GI) to enable elimination

best_oleating_substances.note: Best overall oleant — absorbs properties of processing drugs

best_oleating_substances.best_for: Joints, bones, vital organs, GI tract, burns, injuries, prolapsed uterus, ear and head diseases
Vata disorders, tumors, sinus, worms, kapha, medo roga, krura kostha

types_of_snehana.purpose: To mobilize dosas for elimination (purva karma for panchakarma)
Palliative oleation — mitigate dosas without eliminating

types_of_snehana.timing: Mixed with mutton soup, wine, or food
types_of_snehana.purpose: Body nourishment — for debilitated, elderly, children

eligible_persons: Habituated to wine, excessive coitus, heavy exercise
contraindications: Very weak OR very strong digestive power
Immediately after nasya, vasti, or virecana

purva_karma: Give mild carminative drugs (dipana) to stimulate digestion
Assess kostha type: mrdu = 3 days, madhyama = 5 days, krura = 7 days
Kostha pariksa: jaggery/sugarcane juice/milk/whey/rice pudding/ghee/grape juice — purgative = mrdu; no effect = krura
pradhana_karma: Administer medicated oil orally, 15–30 min after sunrise, empty stomach
Give hot water immediately after for digestion and mouth cleansing
Patient covers body with thick clothes, stays in breeze-free room
Warm water given at intervals when thirsty
paschat_karma: Use only warm water for drinking and bathing
Avoid rain, cold, sunlight, breeze exposure
Avoid loud talking and excessive eating
Use comfortable pillows (not too high or low)

signs_of_completed_digestion_jima: Disappearance of headache and above symptoms
panchakarma_protocols.confirmation_test: Give hot water — clear eructation = fully digested; oily eructation = still digesting
signs_of_improper_oleation: Exact opposite of proper oleation signs
complication_management: Khala, uddala, yava, syamaka, kodrava, pippali, triphala, ksoudra, pathya, gomutra, guggulu (as per dosa)

sadyosneha_yoga.description: Instant oleation recipes — ideal for children, aged, and non-compliant patients
recipes: Mutton soup (concentrated, more meat less water)
Peya (thin gruel) fried with oleating substances
Pahca prasrta peya: 1 prasrta (100ml) each of ghee, sesame oil, muscle fat, bone marrow + rice
sadyosneha_yoga.note: Mix all with lavana (salt) — for abhisyandi, snigdha, suksma, usna, vyavayi guna

procedure_after_snehapana.for_virecana: After snehapana → unctuous + liquid + hot mutton soup → sudation 3 days → administer purgative drug
procedure_after_snehapana.for_vamana: After snehapana → unctuous + liquid + hot mutton soup → sudation 1 day → kapha-stirring food (milk, fish, black gram) → administer emetic drug
procedure_after_snehapana.for_kapha_dominant: In muscular/fatty persons with kapha dominance — give drying drugs before snehapana for a few days to prevent complications

secondary_therapies: Anuvasana vasti with gingili oil and mutton soup
special_measures: Alcohol from corn flour and jaggery

primary_therapies: Purgation with madhura + sita virya drugs
external_therapies: Garlands of pearls, gems, lotus, jasmine

combined_dosa_treatment.kapha_vata: Follow regimen of Vasanta (spring) season (vata has yoga vahi guna)

staging_treatment.prakopa: Treat increased dosa without disturbing other dosas

ama_theory.definition: Rasa dhatu formed improperly due to weak agni, accumulating abnormally in the stomach
ama_theory.alternative_definition: Forms from intimate mixing of vitiated dosas (like poison from mixing kodrava varieties)

nirama_dosa_signs.kapha: Clear fluid, non-slimy, mixed with water, white, sweet

sama_dosa_treatment: Do NOT forcefully eliminate when dosas are mixed with ama
First administer dipana (carminative) and pacana (digestive) drugs
Convert sama dosa to nirama dosa
Then apply snehana, svedana, followed by suitable sodhana

routes_of_elimination.oral_route: Eliminates dosas from amasaya (stomach) via emesis
routes_of_elimination.nasal_route: Eliminates dosas from head and above shoulders
routes_of_elimination.rectal_route: Eliminates dosas from large intestines via vasti

drug_administration_timings.name_english: At beginning and end of meals (drug split into 2 parts)
indications: Dosas in upper and lower body
drug_administration_timings.note: Drug = powder/paste with digestive property; light small food

drug_administration_timings.name_english: Mixed with one morsel of food

pathogenesis: Excessive heavy food → indigestion → ama formation
Ama + kapha at tissue level → weakens tissues → increases meda (fat)
Channels (srotas) blocked → vata enters GI → increased digestive fire
Increased hunger → excessive food intake → obesity
signs_and_symptoms: Lassitude, decreased lifespan, strength and vigor
Accumulation of fat in abdomen, buttocks, thighs
disease_treatment_data.treatment_principle: Langhana (reducing therapy); drugs that are tiksna (sharp), usna (hot), ruksa (dry), scarifying

formulations.name: Triphala + Guduci + Haritaki + Musta with honey
Rasahjana + Brhatpancamula + Guggulu + Silajatu with Agnimantha svarasa
Vidanga + Sunthi + Yavaksara + Lohabhasma + Amalaki + Barley with honey
Vyosadi Yoga
formulations.method: Equal parts of all 24; add equal madhu (honey), ghrta (ghee), taila (oil) separately; mix 16 parts saktu (corn flour); take regularly
formulations.anupana: Mixed with honey, ghee, and oil

disease_treatment_data.prognosis_note: Emaciation (karsya) is better than obesity — no fully effective treatment for excess fat

complications_of_excessive_langhana: Decreased unctuousness, digestive power, sleep, vision, hearing
Pain in bladder, heart, head, calves, thighs, hip, flanks
disease_treatment_data.treatment_principle: Brmhana (nourishing therapy); sweet, unctuous foods and comforts
diet_recommended: Meat (especially carnivorous animals — best for body mass)
